opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term position, based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, have teaching and admin duties, and be able to include up to two co‑applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: The APEX Awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross‑disciplinary research) support established independent researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research that benefits wider society, requiring collaboration across the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK‑based researcher of any career stage; must have prior public‑engagement experience and cannot have previously received this award.
opportunities.summary: SHAPE Involve and Engage offers up to £8,000 to support innovative public‑engagement projects that connect humanities and social sciences research with galleries, archives, libraries, museums or performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: A call for early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day Knowledge Frontiers Symposium (21‑23 April 2027) on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’, with travel, accommodation and visa costs covered.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation, must have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, and must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year postdoctoral fellowships (funded by DSIT) for outstanding early‑career researchers to undertake independent research leading to a significant publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, resident in the UK, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards to develop skills and capacities (e.g., quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities, languages) supporting innovative research methods, interdisciplinary work and career development.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with a UK university or research institute appointment; must involve overseas co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE or STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Supports 24‑month projects on the theme of Mobilities, requiring genuine interdisciplinary collaboration between UK researchers and international partners, with up to £300k (80% FEC) per award.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Two one‑year fellowships hosted at the German Council on Foreign Relations in Berlin, offering up to £150k to develop policy‑relevant analysis in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £4,000 (or higher in exceptional cases) to support additional needs such as equipment for disabled researchers, caring costs, or assistance with applying to a British Academy call.
